personal.modulesCreatedDescription: This is the total amount of modules you have created with all your characters.
personal.moneySpentDescription: This is the total amount of ISK spent on creating modules with today's prices (avg. in Jita)
personal.totalValueDescription: This is the total value of all modules you created with all your characters.
personal.disclaimer: Keep in mind that these stats are based on the average prices in Jita, and may not reflect the actual value of the modules and their source materials.
